name: Server
description: Server that host instances or other software.

cloud_provider_id.label: Cloud provider
cloud_provider_id.help: Select the provider before selecting a region.

extref_server_id.label: External server ID
extref_server_id.description: Server identifier assigned by the external cloud provider.
extref_server_id.help: This value is synchronized automatically after cloud provisioning.

region_id.label: Region
region_id.description: Geographic cloud region hosting the server.
region_id.help: Only regions belonging to the selected provider are available.

deployment_zone_id.label: Deployment zone
deployment_zone_id.description: Provider-specific deployment target hosting the server.
deployment_zone_id.help: Only deployment targets from the selected geographic region are available.

zone_id.label: Legacy deployment zone
zone_id.description: Legacy deployment target reference retained for data migration.
zone_id.help: This hidden field is copied to the current deployment zone during package initialization.

instances_count.label: Quantity of instances
instances_count.description: Quantity of instance running on server.

action.add-check.label: Add check
action.add-check.description: Create an editable server check from an example.

action.add-alert-trigger.label: Add alert trigger
action.add-alert-trigger.description: Create a server alert trigger and its checks from an example.

region_id.invalid_cloud_provider: The region must belong to the selected cloud provider.

deployment_zone_id.invalid_region: The deployment zone must belong to the selected region.

errors.invalid_cloud_provider: A cloud provider and one of its regions are required, and the region must belong to that provider.
errors.invalid_region: The deployment zone must belong to the selected region.
